title: Synthetic demo: intermittent fasting and glycaemic control in type 2 diabetes
research_question: 间歇性禁食是否能改善2型糖尿病成人的血糖控制？

sub_questions.question: 与常规饮食相比，间歇性禁食是否改善2型糖尿病成人的HbA1c等血糖指标？
间歇性禁食在2型糖尿病成人中的依从性如何？
65岁以上老年2型糖尿病患者的长期（≥12个月）心血管结局证据如何？

sources.title: Synthetic trial A: intermittent fasting and HbA1c at 12 weeks
sources.abstract: In this synthetic demonstration record, adults with type 2 diabetes assigned to intermittent fasting showed a significant reduction in HbA1c at 12 weeks compared with the control diet. Adherence was moderate in the fasting arm.

sources.title: Synthetic trial B: intermittent fasting versus usual care at 24 weeks
sources.abstract: In this synthetic demonstration record, the trial found no significant difference in HbA1c between intermittent fasting and usual care at 24 weeks. Adherence was low in the fasting arm.

sources.title: Synthetic narrative review: implementing intermittent fasting in diabetes care
sources.abstract: This synthetic review describes clinician training and implementation support as considerations for diabetes care. It reports no primary glycaemic outcome data.

criteria.scope: Synthetic demonstration only; no real clinical claim is made or implied.
criteria.include: Only the three synthetic records in this demo case.
criteria.exclude: External literature, network retrieval and real patient data.
